meta.name: Magneta — DECOMMISSION XChainLpReceiver (Gnosis)
meta.description: Neutralise the dormant MagnetaXChainLpReceiver at 0xeca6092e37E9d0692C21294473aDD604D9331fA9 by pointing its keeper at the burn address, so nobody can call fulfillSigned again. Sentinelleai report 18 F-3 (CRITICAL): fulfillSigned only checks that address(this).balance >= intent.amountNative — it never attributes the bridged native to a depositor or a bridge message, so a signer can claim more than they bridged, spending native that belongs to other pending intents. The panel's own remediation is 'do not redeploy or fund this path; confirm the dormant deployment has zero balance and disable its keeper'. Balance verified at 0 on 2026-07-31. setKeeper(address(0)) is rejected by the contract (ZeroAddress), hence the burn address. NOTE: the permissionless addLiquidityNative path stays callable, which is acceptable — it spends only the caller's own msg.value and cannot touch pooled funds. This contract was a 2026-05-27 pilot that the 2026-07-05 journal already flagged for decommissioning; it appears in no deployment manifest.
